Maya: Hi folks, quick onboarding q: my offer says benefits start on my first day (May 2) but portal shows 05/15. Also my first paycheck didn't include the moving reimbursement—recruiter submitted it. Any idea?
Jordan (People Ops): Welcome Maya! For the start date, sometimes the carrier uses the payroll effective date. DM me your employee ID and I'll request a carrier correction. For the reimbursement, can you share the original filename?
Maya: ID 7722. The receipt file was 'move_expense_apr22.pdf'.
OnboardBot: Automated: new hire Maya (ID 7722) onboarding checklist created. Benefits verification pending.
Felix (Payroll): Hi Maya — payroll here. I see a pending reimbursement but it lacks the GL code. Please re-upload the receipt using pattern `reimburse_YYYY-MM-DD_LastName.pdf` and set category 'Relocation' in the form; tag me when done.
Maya: Re-uploaded as 'reimburse_2026-04-22_Maya.pdf' and tagged @Felix.
Felix (Payroll): Thanks—I'll route it for approval. Reimbursements run every two weeks; once approved it posts next cycle.
Ivy (Benefits): FYI about start date: if employer-paid promo was applied, employee premium may show as $0 until the first deduction cycle. If carrier delay, we can request backdate to 05/02; Jordan will handle with carrier. Also if you plan to add your partner to dental, you'll need marriage certificate + dependent SSN digits within 30 days.
Maya: One more: where do I upload a voided check? Portal has Upload Documents but im not sure which category.
Jordan (People Ops): Upload under Payroll > Bank Info. JPG or PDF preferred; avoid .heic. Filename like `7722_Maya_voidcheck.pdf`.
Maya: Uploaded as requested.
Felix (Payroll): Got it. Bank verification is pending micro-deposits (1-2 business days). If you need faster, send an official bank PDF and we can manually verify same day.
Maya: Great—thanks everyone!
Jordan (People Ops): Welcome aboard :tada: Ping here if anything else pops up.
